ballPolicy: The basketball is rendered separately. Dorian controls it with a compact right-handed shooting motion and releases once from his fingertips at frame5/tick13. It is not painted into the poses.

cleanup.method: alpha-connected component isolation and nearest-pixel reassignment

review.reviewNotes: Ten distinct complete right-facing Dorian poses show a controlled gather, compact right-handed jump shot, open palm release at frame5/tick13, follow-through and balanced recovery. Face, dense purple curls, warm brown skin, compact human anatomy and purple/silver Chicago kit remain consistent.
